global_style: An elegant, Morandi-toned presentation theme featuring minimalist layouts, fluid organic background shapes, and delicate botanical line art.

identity_anchors: Delicate, hand-drawn botanical line-art vectors in corners
Fluid, organic solid-color shapes anchoring the edges of the canvas
Warm, low-saturation earth tones (Morandi colors) for all graphic elements
High-contrast classic serif headings mixed with clean sans-serif body text

density_rules.low: Use one focal idea and generous whitespace.
density_rules.medium: Use two to six concise content groups on the observed grid.
density_rules.high: Remove decoration before reducing label size or hierarchy.

variation_rules: Vary image/text balance and emphasis while preserving anchors, grid, and color ratios.
anti_repetition_rules: Do not repeat the same primary composition or decoration placement on adjacent slides.
